items.title: Wayne Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: names you don’t know, the leader was a guy by the name of — a very good arranger and trombone player — “Chick” Cicchetti

ctx.x: Tell me about your first kind of road experience. Was it an eye opener? Were your parents, like, into it?

Yeah, what happened is I had been down — oh when I left the Schillinger House this guy that was in the school wanted me to get a bunch of musicians together to go down to Myrtle Beach and play for the summer at this place down there. So we went down to this place and did some rehearsing and everything else. A lot of it was arrangements from a band we had in Hartford prior to me going. Oh, how I knew I wanted to write music, now we’re getting a little off the track. When I was in high school I got called into the…
What kind of money were you making?
